title: SkillContract
description: SimFlow skill contract schema (SKILL.md frontmatter for built-in and project custom skills)

skill_name.description: Unique built-in SimFlow skill identifier or project custom skill entry point

skill_type.description: Public Skill role. Runtime policy, persistence, and verification are not Skill types.

stage_binding.description: Optional compatibility metadata. Skill selection follows current intent, not the active workflow stage.

intent_binding.description: User intents that may select this Skill independently of cwd or project phase.

agent_binding.description: Primary agent role for this skill

task_shapes.description: Task shape patterns that trigger this skill. Used by the task-shape-aware router (P3.4) to suggest MCP engagement for all task types, including single-stage compute tasks.
